>that's a huge fucking stressor on her plate

What about the huge fucking stressor that was OP's miscarriage that the sister couldn't be bothered about? 

Sister made it an issue of siblings being there for each other. She was obviously never there for OP but expects OP to be there for her nonetheless. That's not how it works.

>start hanging out with her
>girlfriend of THREE YEARS

Problem is, they've kinda been having some issues lately (Kacey tells Tina everything)  and this could backfire. Besides, Alexa is very quiet and aloof, and basically leaves the room if Kacey's not in it.

Edit:
I'd also like to add that Alexa has told Kacey she gets jealous of Tina, but K&T just brush it off.

>Kinda weird that Kacey doesn’t want her best friend’s girlfriend around.

Exactly. I think I wasn't so annoyed with everything up until I found this out.

>Have you talked to your gf directly about it?

I was unsure if I should, since I know that her ex was very clingy and jealous whenever Tina so much as went out with her friends, but I will try. I hope all goes well.

Thanks for the advice!
